notes.title: Marinatide Update #6.0.1
notes.content:
Here comes our first post-launch update. The newest patch contains some bug fixes and minor additions. 

Tell us what you think about it and share any suggestions you might have on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/566420/discussions/]forum[/url].

[h1]Marinatide Version 1.0.0.1 - 25.10.2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Minor updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Added tutorial message after buying fishing device for the tutorial, to remind player to go talk to Simon
[*]Added ending music
[/list]
[*][b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed the delay between fishing device being ready and being able to pick it up
[*]Added keyboard support for the first screen before entering Alstport for the first time
[*]Music now plays in Main Menu
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Marinatide 1.0 Is Out
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27233472/7eb70c241c95fa270083b3ff6e3e7ed367d25263.png[/img]

Marinatide 1.0 is now officially launched!
It’s been about ten months since we entered Steam Early Access, inviting you to participate in the development process of Marinatide. Thank you for playing and for sharing your comments with us! The game has made some great progress over this time, hopefully you like it.

The new Marinatide trailer:
https://youtu.be/a7pXj-9yneA
As we have announced in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/566420/announcements/detail/1458463563380702442]our previous post[/url] earlier this week, the new version is coming with a massive update. We would love to hear what you have to say about it, so please share your thoughts on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/566420/discussions/]the forum.[/url]

Below is the full changelog of this update.

[h1]Marinatide Version 1.0 - 19.10.2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Major Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Main story finished
[*]Island Quests (3)
[*]Improved Side quest mechanics
[*]More side quests
[*]More seasons
[*]Winter
[*]New Islands
[*]Different species of fish in areas on winter and summer
[*]Floating Garbage
[*]Garbage collection boats
[*]Environmental garbage visual
[*]Fish area info accessible through world map
[*]Season can be restarted from main menu
[*]Fish Traps visible through map
[*]Quest Log
[/list]
[*][b]Minor Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]More Hotkeys for keyboard
[*]Small UI improvements
[*]Map can be scrolled
[/list]
[*][b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]New fishing equipment becomes available as game progresses
[*]Easier progression goals
[*]Species more territorial
[*]Smaller pools of fish species when generating fish areas
[*]Shops should sell you items that help you get the fish in the area
[*]Small adjustments to fish prices
[*]Higher level gear price increased
[*]Higher level rods get better fish
[*]Resting in boat recovers slightly more
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Marinatide 1.0 Coming October 19th!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27233472/53088a8341bcaed7e47892b9e12dc83a98604729.png[/img]

We have big news: the 1.0 launch of Marinatide is just around the corner! The new version of the game will be available on Steam this Thursday–October 19th.

[h1]What’s New[/h1]

The full game is coming with a big update, adding some major features to the current version. There will be significant visual changes to the world of the game, as the looks of island areas will change with the passing of seasons. Summer and Winter each have their own look. But it’s not only seasonal changes that alter the landscapes. Excess of garbage in an area will take its toll on the scenery, too. In addition to that, there is a whole new variety of garbage added - the floating trash is now waiting for you to clean it up!

Another visual change (though, purely cosmetic) is the new boats. You’ll be able to unlock different vessels in the game. This will not change your boat’s technical capabilities, but it will allow you to roam around in style.

Among other things is the availability of fancy fishing gear. With the new update, the shop stock will be changing as you progress in the game, bringing more expensive and effective tools to the market. This will give you more opportunities to invest in quality gear–pricy, but totally worth it!

There are also new quests introduced in Marinatide 1.0–you’ll now have Island Quests (and a couple of new islands) to adventure. Some of the major islands will have their own missions for you. As for the Main Quest–the story will be expanded, with several different endings available. What does the future hold for Team Marina? You’ll see for yourself next week!

[h1]Pricing [/h1]

For those who don’t own Marinatide yet: it might be a good time to grab yourself a copy. As our Early Access run is ending, the price for the game is about to go up. Starting from the launch day, October 19th, Marinatide will cost 6.99$/6.99€.

A trailer for the new version will be coming soon!

notes.title: Marinatide Update #5
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27233472/c4b1364f2e1d80108b14da0390753330af6676eb.png[/img]

It’s time again for Marinatide update. In Version 0.7, we are expanding the playing field!

Expanding the player map significantly, we are introducing two new islands and over a hundred of new Fish Areas. In addition to that, we’ve also made some adjustments to the way Fish Areas work. 

You can find more details about Update #5 in our [url=https://marinatide.tumblr.com/]devblog[/url].

Let us know what you think of the new areas on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/566420/discussions/]forum[/url]. 

[h1]Marinatide Version 0.7 - 12.07.2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Major Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Rehauled Fish Areas
[*]New Islands with new towns and Fish Areas
[*]Fish is different based on Location
[/list]

[*][b]Minor Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Couple of Side Quests
[*]Couple of new NPC:s
[*]Moved some NPC:s to new islands
[*]Small updates to randomized Side Quests
[*]Rehauled Water Effect
[*]Increased performance
[*]Fishing removes fish from Fish Areas
[*]Fish Areas replenish fish over time
[*]Map can be opened with “M” or “Tab”
[*]Map is centered to player
[*]Less dialogue when entering Inn/Shop (less clicking)
[*]Changed how fish amount is calculated on areas
[*]Bug Fixes
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Marinatide Update #4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27233472/6b4f902475aecbdabd677d97db334c593593d8a7.png[/img]

Hi, everyone. We have just released Marinatide 0.5. Yay, halfway there!

This week, we are bringing the earlier announced update, which introduces sea cleanup and a couple of other handy features. Collect and sell the garbage sunken at sea, navigate by map and take some chill time on your boat, without having to go to an inn.

See our update trailer:
https://youtu.be/8j0GYD0X2Yc
You can find some more update details in [url=https://marinatide.tumblr.com/post/160582574903/update-4-cleaning-navigating-and-resting]our devblog[/url].

Drop by the forums to tell us what you think of the new features!


[h1]Marinatide Version 0.5 - 12.05.2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Major Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Map screen
[*]Sunken garbage
[*]Sunken garbage introduction
[*]Ability to sleep on boat
[/list]

[*][b]Minor Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Passing out no longer teleports the player to Inn, instead it is treated as sleeping in boat for some time
[*]Garbage lowers the amount of fish you get from the polluted area
[*]All fishing devices can fish up garbage
[*]Amount of garbage on a Fish Area can be seen in the info window
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Marinatide Update #3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27233472/d574e426192553ae1aaf15a74c1e33e392b39e6d.png[/img]

It's time for Marinatide 0.45! 

In this update, most of the changes are not going to make any difference to the players just yet. Though, there are a few things that you will already notice. We've made some adjustments to equipping and purchasing of motors, now allowing you to switch between the ones you own freely. In addition to that, there are new Side Quests and some new dialogue with them.

Lastly, there are now time penalties for passing out in your boat, instead of going to an inn for sleep, so manage your time carefully!

Check more update details in our [url=https://marinatide.tumblr.com/post/159822549248/update-3-motor-switching-and-new-dialogue]devblog[/url].

Drop by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/566420/discussions/]our forum[/url] to share your thoughts, and have a nice weekend!


[h1]Marinatide Version 0.45 - 21.04.2017[/h1]
[list]
[*]Minor Updates
[list]
[*]Inventory now shows weight of stack
[*]Engines can be changed without having to buy them again
[*]Items with a stack size of 1 can only be bought if not already in inventory
[*]Added some fish for new Fish Areas
[*]Version number added to main menu
[*]Passing out now takes 10 hours instead of 8 to make it slightly more enticing to rest at the inn.
[*]A new Side Quest (Giver: Shopkeeper, Alstport)
[*]Added new Dialogue (Shopkeeper, Alstport)
[*]Text size adjustment: "Quest Complete!"
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Marinatide Update #2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27233472/e93f7735f6c5d7c931e4cae0fdd7d331aa8c04a4.png[/img]

Hey-hey! The second Marinatide feature update is here.

Version 0.4 is bringing some major changes to the way Fish Areas work. From now on, you can get information about the fish available in each area from the Fish Area Info Window. Not to make it too easy for you, we've also added Fish Area Randomization, making the selection of the available Fish Areas different on each playthrough.

We've written a [url=https://marinatide.tumblr.com/post/159300128298/update-2-fish-areas-defined-and-randomized]blog post[/url], reviewing Update #2 in more detial. 

Drop by the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/566420/discussions/1/]forum[/url] and let us know what you think!

[h1]Marinatide Version 0.4 - 07.04.2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Major Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Fish Area Info Window, which shows the overall value of the area and what has been caught from it
[*]Fish Areas now have a degree of randomization - there are more places a fish area can appear, but some familiar spots might not have one
[/list]
[*][b]Minor Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Added variance to fishing quests
[*]A new Side Quest
[*]Manual saving
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Marinatide Update #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27233472/784f98c7b4536075066797fa6e11a85c52e56dfa.jpg[/img]

Hi, everyone. We have just put out the first Marinatide feature update. Hooray!  

In Marinatide 0.3, we addressed some of the issues that were mentioned in the forum posts and reviews, including the tutorial difficulty, keyboard navigation and Steam Cloud saves. On top of all that, we added Side Quests!

You can read more details about the update in our [url=http://marinatide.tumblr.com/]devblog[/url].

Have a nice weekend and be sure to drop by the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/566420/discussions/]forum[/url] and let us know what you think of the update! 

[h1]Marinatide Version 0.3 - 23.03.2017[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Major Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Side Quests
[*]Keyboard support improved (rebindable in launcher)
[*]Most menus navigable using keyboard
[*]Steam Cloud saves
[/list]
[*][b]Minor Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Fish on the looting screen no longer completely overlap
[*]Dialogue can be skipped by pressing escape
[*]Tutorial changes
[list]
[*]Added an optional fishing quest
[*]Tutorial will no longer TAKE ALL YOUR MONEY
[*]Endangered fish no longer appear on the tutorial
[/list]
[*]Small bug fixes
[*]Misc text edits
[/list]
[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Inventory and shop screens should now always start from proper position
[*]Loading caused some issues with Fishing devices being able to be looted as soon as they were visible, this should work as intended now
[/list]
[/list]
